description: Use for a quick feed of what New Runtime published in the last 1-14 days (news signals, analyses, field notes, weekly knowledge updates), newest first, at most 40 items with title, date, URL and a one-line why. Free, no auth. Example: {"days": 7, "kinds": ["signal", "analysis"]}. For what changed against what you already knew, use what_changed.

kinds.description: Optional subset of kinds; default all.
